conflicts_identified: GL-101 (v1.0, Approved, owner Avery Example (SYNTHETIC)) defines 'Settlement Date' as the date on which cash and securities are exchanged to complete a trade (the actual exchange). GL-204 (v2.1, Approved, owner Blake Example (SYNTHETIC)) defines it as the contractual date by which payment and delivery must complete, as agreed at execution (the contractual due date). These are not equivalent: one describes when settlement actually occurs, the other the agreed deadline. The two entries are linked as possible_duplicate. Neither is picked here.

Recorded CDE flags differ between the two entries: GL-101 has recorded_cde_flag true, GL-204 has recorded_cde_flag false. This is a recorded value only; this agent does not declare or change CDE status.
